title: Electron-hosted Karma and cross-layer qualification
summary: Aligned unit and browser-driven checks with the desktop application renderer and headless execution environment.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Built an Electron-bound Karma workflow using dynamic loopback ports, isolated run state/logs and Playwright proofs in the same renderer/headless environment.
Added focused cross-layer vertical runners and stabilized CPU/RHEL8 execution, fixture readiness, mocking and renderer expectations.
